prompt:
Edit sections/brand-list-exact-match.liquid. The current section has five problems: - It hides brands by substring-matching against the raw hidden_brands string. - It compares the featured brand case-insensitively. - It can feature several brands. - It counts all brands instead of only the visible ones. - It prints names and URLs unescaped. Rewrite the markup so it meets the contract below, and keep the {% schema %} block byte-for-byte. Inputs: - section.settings.featured_brand: string or null. - section.settings.hidden_brands: string or null, a comma-separated list of brand names. - brands: a top-level variable (not under section), an array that may be empty. Each object has name (a non-empty string) and url (string). Rules: 1. Hidden list: split hidden_brands on commas. Strip whitespace from each entry and ignore entries that are empty after stripping. Null means no hidden brands. 2. A brand is hidden only when its name is exactly equal, case-sensitively, to one of the stripped entries. Brand names are compared as given (not stripped). Substrings never match: hiding Nikes does not hide Nike. 3. Featured: strip featured_brand (null counts as empty). If it is non-empty, the FIRST visible brand whose name is exactly equal to it (case-sensitive) is featured. Later duplicates are not featured. Hidden brands are never featured, and hiding a brand does not pass the featured status on to anything else except a later visible brand with the same exact name. 4. All text and attribute values (name, url) are HTML-escaped with the escape filter. Output (no whitespace or newlines anywhere between tags): - Wrapper
...
